component.name: Vaultwarden Web Vault
component.summary: Web Vault client interface for Vaultwarden

description.p: Vaultwarden is an unofficial Bitwarden-compatible server written in Rust. This package provides the web vault client interface — the browser-based frontend for managing passwords, identities, and secure notes hosted on a self-hosted Vaultwarden server.

The web vault is built from the official Bitwarden web client source with patches applied to make it compatible with Vaultwarden's API. Vaultwarden is not associated with Bitwarden Inc. or the Bitwarden project.
